headline: Jefferies downgrades Cigna to Hold on mounting 2027 earnings headwinds
summary: Investing.com -- Jefferies downgraded Cigna to Hold from Buy, arguing that a growing list of earnings headwinds and limited catalysts outweigh the stock's discounted valuation, while cutting its price target to $307 from $336.
